headline: Ordinances on elderly and disabled tax exemption income limits, gasoline, electricity, and natural gas contracts, and High Street and School Street garage parking permits.
summary: Items include an ordinance to increase elderly and disabled tax exemption income limits. Other items cover fuel and utility contracts, parking permits for the High Street and School Street garages, and two camping-related ordinances tabled earlier.
items: Communication from Contract Assessor Supervisor Robert J. Gagne on the elderly and disabled exemption review for the 2027 tax year
Interview: Dalia Ragas for Office of Deputy Treasurer/Tax Collector, term indefinite
Interview: Cathy Prevost for Arts Commission (new appointment), term to expire December 22, 2029
Application to license hawker's, peddler's, or itinerant vendor's license
Appointment by the Board of Aldermen: Dalia Ragas, Office of Deputy Treasurer/Tax Collector, term indefinite
Mayor's appointment: Cathy Prevost, Arts Commission, term to expire December 22, 2029
Mayor's re-appointment: Lisa Tourangeau, Citizens Advisory Commission, term to expire October 1, 2029
Mayor's re-appointment: Jennifer Bishop, Citizens Advisory Commission, term to expire November 1, 2029
Ordinance O-26-025: increasing the elderly and disabled tax exemption maximum allowed individual and combined net income amounts
Ordinance O-26-026: regarding approvals for gasoline, electricity, and natural gas contracts and purchasing extensions or renewals
Ordinance O-26-027: amendment to parking permits, High Street Garage
Ordinance O-26-028: amendment to parking permits, School Street Parking Garage
Ordinance O-26-004, tabled at 5/4/26 meeting: repealing the prohibition on camping on public property
Ordinance O-26-005, tabled at 5/4/26 meeting: repealing the prohibition on campers and recreational vehicles on public property
